text_block_list.text: (CRACK!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah~~! I've totally messed up~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My precious pen is... Oh, what a complete 
and utter blockhead I am~~!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: P-Please calm down, Kawakami-san!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If you squeeze my hand too tightly, you'll 
get hurt, you know~?

While looking things up in the library, I 
heard a commotion from another desk. Looks 
like the source of the fuss is Kawakami 
Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...! Please listen, of all the 
things I could have done...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I ended up breaking my pen! And after I 
took such good care of it, too...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was a matching pen King-san 
gave me~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, dummy! I just explained this part to 
you a minute ago!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Mmph... uuuugh! Please, just one more try!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, why does it take you so long to 
memorize this...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. I'll give you this 
pen, so write it out over and over to 
hammer it into your head!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it is alright? If I recall, 
this pen is a special item that only 
first-class individuals may possess...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, guiding those who strive is what 
makes someone first-rate! The King is 
generous, you know!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Use that pen well, and aim to be 
first-class like me!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san was so adorable back then, 
making such a huge fuss going, "I got a 
pen!"~

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because I admire King-san so much. She 
excels in both academics and sports, and 
she's always working so hard...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I was trying my hardest with 
that crown pen, so I could catch up to 
King-san."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To think I went and broke it~! I feel so 
utterly foolish, I could punch 
myself~~~!!!
choice_data_list: The effort you put in won't go to waste.

The effort you put in won't go to waste, 
you know.

Wouldn't King Halo actually be delighted 
instead?

Don't you think King Halo would actually 
be happy about that?

text_block_list.text:
To think I went and broke it~! I feel so

myself~~~!!!
choice_data_list: The effort you put in won't go to waste.

The effort you put in won't go to waste, 
you know.

Wouldn't King Halo actually be delighted 
instead?

Don't you think King Halo would actually 
be happy about that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No! My efforts pale in comparison!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! Your test scores 
have gone up by 3 whole points since then, 
haven't they?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"So really, that was all thanks to your 
pen, King-san...!"
choice_data_list: It's not the pen that's special, it's you!
It's not the pen that's special, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! Kawakami-san studied super 
hard, and that's why her score went up!"

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Studying every single day without getting 
discouraged... I think that's truly 
amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone... *sniff*... uuu...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am simply delighted~! I am so moved, 
tears are welling up in my eyes~~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to do my best! So that all 
those days spent striving alongside my pen 
will not go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Great! Shall we get back to studying then?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Once we're done, let's go look for the 
same pen to see if they sell it, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~! There is nothing quite 
like having kind comrades~~!

Kawakami Princess resumed her studies with 
a new pen. It seems she is blessed with 
good friends.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I broke her pen, so why is King-san 
happy about it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Who called for this first-rate King?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fugyaaah!? K-K-K-King-san!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Kawakami-san. Well then? How 
do you plan to entertain first-class King 
today?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hagyuuu, n-no, you've got it all wrong~! 
The truth is, well, umm—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... You studied so hard you ended up 
completely worn out."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am so very sorry! After King went to all 
the trouble of giving me such a 
treasure~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, why be ashamed of proof that you 
fought with all your might? Hold your head 
higher!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To think you wanted to get this close to 
the King— I must praise your ambition!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they were really delighted, weren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fuuugh, I-I'm so happy...! As expected of 
King-san, you have an insanely big heart~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it is! Now, let's see how much 
progress you've made with your studies! 
You'd best be grateful for my first-rate 
tutelage!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, seriously! Why did you get the part 
I just taught you wrong again! Here, I'll 
give you a new pen, so study a little 
harder!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyawaa~~n! I-I'll do my best~~!

And so, with King Halo joining in, the 
four resumed their study session. Watching 
their close friendship brought a smile to 
my face.
